label: Defold
projectSubfolderHint: Folder relative to the Defold project root. The map folder is created inside it; for example: exported/forest.
collisionHint: Export the resolved manual Collision layers as static boxes.
projectSubfolder: Use a subfolder inside the Defold project. Drive paths, network paths and .. are not allowed.
tileSize: {tileset}: Tile size {width} × {height} px does not match the {mapWidth} × {mapHeight} px map cell. Defold requires matching sizes.
layerOpacity: {layer}: Defold does not support layer opacity. Set opacity to 100% or exclude the layer from export.
overlappingArt: {layer}: Overlapping artwork extending outside its cell cannot be exported faithfully to Defold.
missingTexture: {tileset}: PNG image is missing. Reload the image before exporting.
textureLayout: {tileset}: The PNG outer margin cannot be converted losslessly. Check that the image is valid and matches the tileset grid.
tileIndex: {layer}: Defold''s last supported file tile index is 65534. Split the tileset into smaller sources.
